records.title: Aerodynamics
records.description: Aerodynamics as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
records.guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Does the installation affect any external aerodynamic surface?
Are any external protrusions, inlets, outlets or drains identified and their positions agreed?
Are aerodynamic loads on externally exposed items estimated for the flight envelope?
Are external mould line changes, steps and gaps within the agreed aerodynamic tolerances?
Are inlet and outlet flows (vents, drains, cooling air) assessed for effect on drag and local flow?
Are aerodynamic loads provided to Structural Analysis for the preliminary sizing?
Are surface finish, step and gap tolerances on the external surface stated on the drawings?
Are final aerodynamic loads confirmed against the released aerodynamic data set?
Are any items in disturbed flow (for example behind protrusions) assessed for buffet and fatigue?

records.draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.

records.title: Affordability and Cost
records.description: Affordability and Cost as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
records.guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is a cost target for the installation set and agreed with the Sub-team?
Are the main cost drivers (bought-in equipment, materials, processes) identified?
Have lower-cost architecture options been considered and the choice recorded?
Is the cost of the installation within the Sub-team allocation?
Are part count and the number of unique parts minimised where practicable?
Are tooling and test equipment costs estimated and included?
Is the final cost estimate within target, or is any overrun recorded as an Issue?
Are standard and common parts used in preference to new made parts where they meet the need?
Are tolerances no tighter than function requires, to avoid unnecessary manufacturing cost?

records.draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.

records.title: Airworthiness and Certification
records.description: Airworthiness and Certification as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
records.guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is the applicable certification basis for the installation identified?
Are the certification requirements allocated to the installation listed with a planned means of compliance?
Is the installation's safety and airworthiness significance (Safety Classification) proposed?
Is the means of compliance for each applicable requirement agreed (analysis, test, inspection, similarity)?
Are any novel or unusual design features identified and discussed with the airworthiness authority if needed?
Are certification evidence documents planned with owners and dates?
Is compliance evidence complete, or planned and tracked, for every applicable requirement?
Are Compliance Statements recorded for every inherited and direct Requirement of the FDPS?
Are any non-compliances raised as Issues and visible at release?

records.draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.

records.title: Assembly, Interfaces, Tolerances and Interchangeability
records.description: Assembly, Interfaces, Tolerances and Interchangeability as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
records.guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are the installation's physical interfaces with other FDPSs and Systems identified?
Is the build sequence (aircraft Build Station or Bench) proposed for each item?
Are interchangeability or replaceability needs identified?
Is a tolerance stack-up done for each critical interface?
Are datum and location features defined consistently with the mating items?
Can the installation be assembled in the proposed sequence without disturbing other installations?
Are interchangeable items interchangeable at every interface?
Are all interface dimensions and tolerances shown on the released definitions?
Are shimming or fettling allowances defined where tolerance stacks cannot be closed by design?

records.draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.

records.title: Configuration Management
records.description: Configuration Management as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
records.guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is the FDPS allocated a number, owning Sub-team and lead Sub-system?
Are all items in the FDPS population linked to a Part Definition?
Is the planned effectivity of the FDPS recorded?
Are Part, Assembly and FDPS numbers allocated under the numbering rules (stem, dash range, handedness)?
Are revisions and effectivity ranges for every item recorded with no gaps or overlaps?
Are changes since the last review recorded as Change Records?
Does the release baseline resolve every member to exactly one revision at every effectivity?
Are superseded definitions and non-interchangeable changes numbered by the roll-by-two rule?
Are all Review Flags on the FDPS dispositioned?

records.draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.

records.title: Design
records.description: Design as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
records.guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is the design concept defined and traceable to its allocated Requirements?
Are the main design options and the reasons for the chosen option recorded?
Are design risks identified and recorded as Risks or Actions?
Is the preliminary design sized and laid out in the integrated model?
Are the applicable TSMs identified and their applicable statements understood?
Are open design Actions from stage A closed or planned?
Is the detail design complete and every Part and Assembly definition ready for release?
Is conformance claimed against every applicable TSM statement, with evidence?
Are all Actions from reviews A, B and C closed before release?

records.draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.

records.title: Electrical Systems
records.description: Electrical Systems as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
records.guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are electrical power, signal and bonding needs of the installation identified?
Are electrical interfaces (connectors, looms, earth points) located in the concept?
Are electrical loads estimated for the power budget?
Are loom routes and connector positions agreed with the installation layout?
Are electrical bonding and earthing paths defined for all metallic items?
Are circuit protection and wire sizing assessed for the preliminary loads?
Are bonding resistance requirements stated and verifiable?
Are all connectors, backshells and clamps specified on the released definitions?
Are electrical test requirements (continuity, insulation, bonding) defined?

records.draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.

records.title: Set pipe clamp spacing from the installed vibration spectrum (generic)
records.summary: Clamp spacing set from static loads alone can lead to fatigue of rigid pipework.
records.what_happened: Generic: fatigue indications on rigid pipework adjacent to clamps after first running.
records.root_cause: Installed vibration spectrum not used for clamp spacing.
records.recommendation: Require installed-spectrum evidence, or an agreed conservative envelope, before accepting clamp spacing.
records.applicability: Rigid pipework supported by clamps in vibration zones.
